summary: Prepare deliberate chat and thread retries as fresh attempts after proven nonapplication

replay.detail: Supersedes the exact-packet retry policy in the earlier thread outbox note: explicit applied:none now permits a deliberate new attempt of the same immutable intent, with a fresh snapshot, action ID and idempotency key. Unknown delivery still never permits Retry or replay. There is no browser transport-level exact-packet resend path.

schema.detail: Reuses the existing browser-local IndexedDB envelope and attachment spool; no browser or server schema version changes or migrations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes or coordinated member upgrades.

compatibility.detail: Protected and visibly unprotected chat, thread Start and reply use the fresh-attempt retry policy. Thread retries revalidate the original recipient or open thread before selecting the fresh fence; failed validation retains the draft and recovery card with its reason. Chat binds each prepared message identity to the existing optimistic row before dispatch to avoid duplicate rows.

downtime.detail: No server interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: New protected retry children require atomic acceptance against an undismissed not-applied predecessor; concurrent tabs converge on one child permit. Original intent, target and attachment bytes are preserved, while old terminal evidence remains intact. Unknown and discarded attempts do not acquire retry permission.
